value.rationale: CEP is the algebraic invariant controlling the local deduction-detachment theorem in the recent source. Locating its exact first finite failure size is a natural structural boundary, and the full eight-element census measures the first layer rather than supplying an isolated example. The closure-operator subcensus is especially relevant to the source program because it shows that the failure already occurs under normality, extensiveness, monotonicity, and idempotence, with only four minimal isomorphism types.
